'''Anatoly Ivanovich Larkin''' ({{langx|ru|Анатолий Иванович Ларкин}}; October 14, 1932 – August 4, 2005) was a Russian [[Theoretical physics|theoretical physicist]].<ref>
[http://www1.umn.edu/news/news-releases/2005/UR_RELEASE_MIG_2371.html Anatoly Larkin, world-renowned physicist, dies: News Releases: UMNnews: U of M<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=In memoriam: Anatoly Larkin {{!}} College {{!}} College of Science and Engineering |url=https://cse.umn.edu/college/feature-stories/memoriam-anatoly-larkin |access-date=2026-02-08 |website=cse.umn.edu |language=en}}</ref>

== Life ==
Born in a small town of [[Kolomna]] in Moscow region, Larkin went on to receive his education at the [[National Research Nuclear University MEPhI (Moscow Engineering Physics Institute)|Moscow Engineering Physics Institute]]. He worked on his PhD on the properties of [[Plasma (physics)|plasmas]] under the supervision of [[Arkady Migdal|A.B.Migdal]] and later received the degree of Doctor of Science (1965) for studies of [[superconductivity]].

Research at the [[Kurchatov Institute|I.V. Kurchatov Institute]] in Moscow (1957–66) was followed by nearly 40 years of work at the [[Landau Institute for Theoretical Physics]] in [[Chernogolovka]], Moscow region, where he moved in 1966. During 1970–1991, he was also a professor at [[Moscow State University]]. Since 1995, Larkin was a professor of physics at the [[University of Minnesota]] and a member of William I. Fine Theoretical Physics Institute.<ref>
[http://www.ftpi.umn.edu/ William I. Fine Institute Homepage]</ref>

The dominant part of his work is devoted to superconductivity, magnetism, ferro-electricity, properties of metals, semiconductors and dielectrics. He pioneered the concept of [[spontaneous symmetry breaking]] in the physics of elementary particles,<ref>
V.G. Vaks, A.I. Larkin, On the application of the methods of superconductivity theory to the problem of the masses of elementary particles, Sov. Phys. JETP 13, 192-193 (1961)
</ref> discovered collective [[Flux pinning|pinning]] of magnetic flux in superconductors,<ref>
A.I. Larkin, Effect of inhomogeneities on the structure of the mixed state of superconductors, Sov. Phys. JETP 31(4), 784 (1970)
</ref> predicted paraconductivity<ref>
L.G. Aslamazov, A.I. Larkin, Effect of Fluctuations on the Properties of a Superconductor Above the Critical Temperature, Sov. Phys. Solid State, 10(4), 875-880 (1968)</ref> and effects of fluctuations on properties of superconductors,<ref>
A. Larkin, A. Varlamov, Theory of fluctuations in superconductors, Oxford University Press, 2005, xviii, 412 pp. {{ISBN|0-19-852815-9}} [International Series of Monographs on Physics 127]
</ref> made essential contributions to the theory of [[weak localization]],<ref>
S. Hikami, A.I. Larkin, Y. Nagaoka, Spin-Orbit Interaction and Magnetoresistance in the Two Dimensional Random System, Prog. Theor. Phys., 63(2), 707-710 (1980)
</ref> as well as developed the concept of the [[Ehrenfest theorem|Ehrenfest time]]<ref>
I.L. Aleiner, A.I. Larkin, Role of divergence of classical trajectories in quantum chaos, Phys. Rev. E 55 (2), R1243-R1246 (1997)
</ref> and [[Out-of-time-ordered correlator|out-of-time-ordered correlators]]<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Larkin |first1=A. I. |last2=Ovchinnikov |first2=Yu N. |date=1969 |title=Quasiclassical Method in the Theory of Superconductivity |url=https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1969JETP...28.1200L/abstract |journal=Soviet Journal of Experimental and Theoretical Physics |language=en |volume=28 |page=1200 |bibcode=1969JETP...28.1200L}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=García-Mata |first=Ignacio |last2=Jalabert |first2=Rodolfo A. |last3=Wisniacki |first3=Diego Ariel |date=2023-04-26 |title=Out-of-time-order correlations and quantum chaos |url=http://www.scholarpedia.org/article/Out-of-time-order_correlations_and_quantum_chaos |journal=Scholarpedia |language=en |volume=18 |issue=4 |pages=55237 |doi=10.4249/scholarpedia.55237  |doi-access=free|issn=1941-6016|arxiv=2209.07965 }}</ref> in quantum chaos.

A.I. Larkin was the teacher of a large number of actively working theorists. His students and collaborators are teaching and conducting research in Russia, USA, Great Britain, France, Italy, Germany, Switzerland, Israel and other countries.

He died suddenly at 6pm on August 4, 2005, in [[Aspen, Colorado|Aspen]], [[Colorado]], where he was attending a physics workshop.

==Honors and prizes==
* [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour]] (1967)
* [[List of Fritz London Memorial Prizes|London Prize in Low Temperature Physics]] (1990)
* Member of [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (1991), corresponding member of the USSR Academy of Sciences (1979)<ref name="ras">{{cite web|url=http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-323.ln-ru|script-title=ru:Ларкин Анатолий Иванович|publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]]|language=Russian|access-date=25 March 2012}}</ref>
* [[EPS Europhysics Prize|Hewlett Packard Europhysics Prize]] (1993)<ref name="PhysToday" />
* [[International Association for Vegetation Science|Alexander von Humboldt Medal]] (1993)
* Award of Excellence of the World Congress on Superconductivity (1994)
* [[Lars Onsager Prize]] (2002)<ref name="PhysToday">{{cite journal|author =Efetov, Konstantin B. |author2=Khmelnitskii, David E. |author3=Ovchinnikov, Yuri N. |author4-link=Paul Wiegmann |author4=Wiegmann, Paul B. |title=Obituary: Anatoly Ivanovich Larkin|journal=Physics Today|date=April 2006|volume=59|issue=4|pages=88–89|doi=10.1063/1.2207057|bibcode = 2006PhT....59d..88E |doi-access=free}}</ref>
* {{ill|John Bardeen Prize|de}}<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bardeen Prize |url=https://physics.illinois.edu/people/honors-and-awards/bardeen-prize |access-date=2024-03-23 |website=University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign|language=en}}</ref> (2004)

==Selected publications==

*A. Larkin, A. Varlamov, Theory of fluctuations in superconductors, Oxford University Press, 2005, xviii, 412 pp. {{ISBN|0-19-852815-9}} [International Series of Monographs on Physics 127]
* V. M. Galitski, A. I. Larkin, Superconducting fluctuations at low temperature, Physical Review B 63 (17), 174506 (2001)
* I. L. Aleiner, A. I. Larkin, Role of divergence of classical trajectories in quantum chaos, Phys. Rev. E 55 (2), R1243-R1246 (1997)
* L. B. Ioffe and A. I. Larkin, Gapless fermions and gauge fields in dielectrics, Phys. Rev. B 39, 8988 (1989)
* A. L. Larkin, Yu.N. Ovchinnikov, Quantum tunneling with dissipation, JETP Lett., 37 (7), 382-385 (1983); Pis’ma v ZhETF, 37 (7), 322-325 (1983)
*S. Hikami, A.I. Larkin, Y. Nagaoka, Spin-Orbit Interaction and Magnetoresistance in the Two Dimensional Random System, Prog. Theor. Phys., 63(2), 707-710 (1980)
*A.I. Larkin, Effect of inhomogeneities on the structure of the mixed state of superconductors, Sov. Phys. JETP 31(4), 784 (1970); (RUS) ZhETF, 58 (4), 1466-1470 (1970)
*A.I. Larkin, D.E. Khmel’nitskii, Phase Transition in Uniaxial Ferroelectrics, Sov. Phys. JETP 29(6), 1123-1128 (1969); (RUS) ZhETF, 56 (6), 2087-2098 (1969)
*L.G. Aslamazov, A.I. Larkin, Effect of Fluctuations on the Properties of a Superconductor Above the Critical Temperature, Sov. Phys. Solid State, 10(4), 875-880 (1968); (RUS) Fizika Tverd. tela, 10 (4), 1104-1111 (1968)
*A.I. Larkin, Yu.N. Ovchinnikov, Nonuniform state of superconductors, Sov. Phys. JETP 20, 762 (1965); (RUS) ZhETF, 47(3), 1136-1146 (1964)
*V.G. Vaks, A.I. Larkin, On the application of the methods of superconductivity theory to the problem of the masses of elementary particles, Sov. Phys. JETP 13, 192-193 (1961); (RUS) ZhETF, 40(1), 282-285 (1961)
*A.A. Vedenov, A.I. Larkin, Equation of state of plasma, Sov. Phys. JETP 9, 806-821 (1959); (RUS) ZhETF, 36(4), 1133-1142 (1959)
